translation.name: Jamaw ta Marbinto: Kabarre ta Gala ɗo bi ka Iisa Masi iŋ daŋla

book.name: Tiit
book.title: Tiit Maktumne taat Pool siiriiji ɗo Tiit

content: Kiŋ Tiit, ɗeelcot kaaw ɗo gee ku Buŋdi a ŋuu karmiyin̰ agindaw ku darrer yoo *gaanuunco. Ɗeelco a ŋuu gine taat sellen̰ ɗo een̰co.
Ɗiyco a ŋuu diyenno kaaw ɗo een̰co, illa ŋuu gine sellen̰ benannico. Ŋuu goye dalullay iŋ gee okin̰co.

Asaan awalle ginte oki gee kuuk oliyay, gi newsiji kop ɗo Buŋdi, gi jag min botol taat samaane. Gi gin ɓerrin ku gamin okin̰co ar ele ka maanni ho gamin kuuk bera galal. Gi el nigen di. Gi hasuudinay. Gi gina taat gi rakiy di. Gi ello ziŋkite.
Kar gay, Buŋ kaak jilinte gaarte selliŋkuwiy iŋ elin̰ji lote okinte.

Ŋa jilinte min ɗo zunuubinnar asaan ŋa tal aminduwte. Ŋa balte jilinte asaan gi gin taat iŋ botilti. Buŋ jilinte iŋ Ruwwiney taat ŋa beriite. Ta acteŋ zunuubinnite. Gi gintu gee kuuk marbinto ho gi ictu goye kaak marbinto.
Buŋ miinteŋ gelbinte iŋ Ruwwin ta Iisa Masi kaak Gay Jilinte beriite.
Ansi-ak, Buŋ iŋ elin̰ji, ŋa gininte gi goyiy iŋ botol ɗo uŋji asaan gii gine kooginay kuuk yaa gase goye ka gaasɗo kaak gi eriyo.
Ka seener, kaaw-an ɗo botilti. Ansii ko, nu rakiy a kiiti wakile ɗo kaaw-anta. Asaan ŋuur kuuk aamin ɗo Buŋdi yaa zeeɗe gine sellen̰. Kaaw taar-an yaa gaayin̰ gee okin̰co.
Kar gay, kaway min gamin ku tambaar, kaway min gee kuuk el giɗuwa ho kuuk el meelo ɗo bi ka gaanuundi. Asaan gamin ar ŋuur-aŋ bal gine paydinco. Ŋu gaayɗo gee.
Ya goy gem kaak el eere gee, karumga, kar kiiji ɗeele pey. Ya ŋa icɗo gay, kiiji newse kopo.
Kiŋ iban kadar gem kaak gina ansi-ak, ŋaar jag min ɗo botol taat samaane. Ya ŋa ɓaa ansi di-ak, ŋa tara ziy ka meen̰ji.
Nu rakaan̰ n̰aame gem rakki kaak ɓaan̰ make : Artemaas wala Tisik. Ya ŋa ote, uc parak ki asiin gasindu koɗok ɗo geeger ka Nikopoliis asaan nun ic niyine, nu raka gaasin ribba eɗe.
Baan̰u, gaayig Zenaas gay ɗukume seriiner, iŋ Apoloos. Obco wero ɗo martuwco. Nu rakaaɗo maan yaaco arme.
Ɗo siŋtite sa, illa ŋuu ibine kadar ŋuu gaaye gee kuuk ya gamin armaaco. Ansii kat, goye ka gee ku Buŋdi uciyɗo maala.
Siŋta okin̰co kuuk goy anne iŋ nunu ooyjiŋ dakina. Kiŋ sa, ni ɗiyaajiŋ : ooyco ɗo siŋtite kuuk elgiite kuuk goy annere. Okiŋko, Buŋ yaako barkiyiŋko. Nu ooyko dakina.
